violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. Cheese bin in walk in cooler had debris buildup inside container. Any food contact surface needs to be cleaned properly on a regular basis.

Prep/vegetable sink. — --Prep sink was not plumbed with a physical air gap on the drain line. Drain line from sink goes below the floor line into the floor drain. Air gap needs to be present two inches above floor line.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Exposed studs, joists or rafters were not covered with smooth, nonabsorbent and easily cleanable material. Back store room with ice machine had exposed studs on two walls. Walls need to be constructed of smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surfaces.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors and walls in walk in cooler were dirty with debris buildup. Detail cleaning required.

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Food removed from original packaging was not placed in a container with an impervious and nonabsorbent cover. - Several food items stored in reach-in freezer without lids or wrapped in pre-portioned bags.
